subject: Hold the countdown — request for 10-day sandbox uplift while procurement closes
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novalabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ethan.rogers@novalabs.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — procurement delay, can we keep the eval live?

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from procurement: our PO is routed but the finance committee pushed it to next week due to a vendor consolidation review. We still need the sandbox for an integration validation that runs Thursday — if it lapses we lose our test window and momentum with engineering.

Would Redwood consider a short uplift (10 days) or a temporary token grant while the PO clears? We don't need a long-term concession — just enough time to complete the test and sign the PO. Happy to sign a one-off agreement confirming we won't exceed agreed usage.

Thanks,
Susan Park
Head of Platform Integrations
Novalabs
Phone: +1 415-555-0173

Attachment: procurement-excerpt.pdf (stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan.park@novalabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — procurement delay, can we keep the eval live?

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up and context.

We can absolutely help preserve your test window. I can approve a 10-day sandbox uplift (temporary tokens + protected usage cap) while your PO finishes routing, with a short terms acknowledgement. Vanessa, can you draft the uplift agreement and include the cap (75k tokens) and a PO number placeholder? David — would finance be comfortable with our standard one-off uplift for this scenario? If you need me to escalate to Sales Ops for a manual approval, I will.

Susan — if that works, please confirm acceptance of the cap and that Novalabs will sign the one-off agreement once the PO clears. I'll attach the uplift stub and send a DocuSign link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sandbox-uplift-agreement.pdf (draft stub)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: quick approval request — Novalabs 10-day uplift (DL-4821)

David / Vanessa,

Novalabs (DL-4821) has a short procurement delay but absolutely needs a Thursday integration window. I'm proposing a 10-day uplift with a 75k token cap and a DocuSign one-off ack that they'll sign when PO completes. They agreed to limit usage to the cap.

Can Finance approve this as a temporary, recoverable uplift? If yes, can we route the DocuSign today so they can sign and we can enable the sandbox before their test? If you prefer, I can reduce the cap to 50k.

Reasoning: preserving momentum reduces risk of deal slip; they're committed and PO is in final routing.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@novalabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@novalabs.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — procurement delay, can we keep the eval live?

Kimberly — yes, that works for us. We accept the 75k token cap and will sign the one-off agreement as soon as you send it. Procurement confirms the PO is in route (PO #NL-2027-0917) but won't clear until Friday. Preserving the environment is critical for our Thursday run.

Please send the DocuSign link and we'll complete it immediately. Appreciate the flexibility.

Cheers,
Ethan Rogers
Senior Eng Manager, Integrations
Novalabs
